api_library: Project Zomboid vanilla Lua/exposed engine APIs
receiver_type: IsoPlayer Stats and exposed SyncPlayerStatsPacket / Lua global
symbol: Minesweeper mood removal and vanilla stat synchronization
returns: Stats.remove returns a changed boolean through add/set; set clamps to stat bounds. getBitMaskForStat returns the ordered-stat bitmask. syncPlayerStats returns no value. Live Lua conversion/replication NOT TESTED.
mutation: Authenticated server/SP authority changes player stats; vanilla SyncPlayerStats targets the owner. No custom Java runtime or client setter.

evidence.statement: Vanilla server harvesting removes boredom and unhappiness through enum Stats.remove.
Vanilla server calls syncPlayerStats after changing a stat.
Vanilla client sends a command with the native player as first argument.
Vanilla server callback receives module, command, native player and arguments and is registered on OnClientCommand.

Exposer.exposeAll passes SyncPlayerStatsPacket to setExposed. Public static getBitMaskForStat computes the ordered-stat bit. GlobalObject.syncPlayerStats sends the vanilla stat packet from server to the target actor; write/parse select those entries. Stats.remove delegates to add/set, with native clamp.
Installed loose mutation/clamp and parse/write methods were compared to the jar; get has an installed optimization. No runtime or effective classloader proof.
